Subject: POC timeline & success criteria — ACME trial planning

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we can align on the POC scope and next steps:  

Summary of needs:
- Evaluate Redwood inference runtime on ACME sample workload (customer support summarization + retrieval-augmented responses)
- Success criteria: latency at 95th pct < 350ms for 512-token responses, inference cost < $0.0009/token (target), and qualitative accuracy on a 50-sample promptset with >= 85% pass rate per ACME QA team
- Data/access: you'll provide a sanitized dataset (S3 link) and service account for temporary access; no customer PII will be included in the POC

Proposed POC plan and timeline:
- Kickoff: week of Jun 15 — 1-hour kickoff to confirm test dataset, success criteria, and owners
- Week 1 (Jun 15–19): infra onboarding, model selection, baseline run
- Week 2 (Jun 22–26): optimization (batching/quantization) and mid-POC checkpoint
- Week 3 (Jun 29–Jul 3): final runs, QA scoring, and readout prep
- Final readout: Jul 6 — 30–45 minute demo + results and recommended next steps

Owners (initial):
- ACME: Samantha Lee (POC sponsor), Tom Garcia (technical lead)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE / POC lead), Connor O'Brien (Solutions Engineer)

Attachments: I attached a brief mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx and our POC checklist (redwood_poc_checklist.pdf) that outline responsibilities and deliverables. Please review and let me know if any success criteria or timelines need adjustment.

Ask: Can we lock a kickoff slot on Jun 16 at 10:00am PT? If not, please propose two alternatives. Also confirm who will be the primary technical contact (Tom OK?).

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa / Dev — forwarding my prep notes for the ACME POC so infra can review. Short checklist below (also attached as redwood_poc_checklist.pdf in my local notes):

Connor's infra checklist (summary):
- IAM/service account with read-only S3 access to supplied bucket; object versions OK
- Temporary credentials (12–24h tokens) acceptable; prefer cross-account role if ACME can set it up
- Expected egress: ~50GB across baseline+final runs — confirm if ACME needs us to route via private connector
- Ports: outbound 443 (HTTPS) only; no inbound required
- If ACME requires VPC peering or PrivateLink, allow 2–3 business days for approvals
